raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-16 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver mixes the two. Late-evening v2 transactions spill into the next UTC date (the 41 rows on 01-19 at 00:00-04:41) or fall in the 00:00-06:00 window. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6, CST in January) before deriving txn_date, so they match the legacy history.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH base AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM base;"}}
